tensorize_integer_list: create a ScriptInteger1DListTensorizer to numberize and tensorize a list of integer lists into a padded PyTorch tensor
tensorize_float_list: create a ScriptFloat1DListTensorizer to numberize and tensorize a list of float lists into a padded PyTorch tensor
tensorize_float_list_seq: create a ScriptFloatListSeqTensorizer to numberize and tensorize nested float lists into a 3D padded PyTorch tensor with sequence lengths
vocab_lookup_tokens: create a VocabLookup module to convert token tuples into vocabulary indices with optional BOS and EOS tokens
configure_tensorizer_padding: create a ScriptTensorizer subclass and configure sequence or batch padding control for TorchScript model input preparation
